title: Nick Bosa suggests Joey Bosa won't play this season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Bosa suggests Joey Bosa won't play this season
sources.description: Defensive end Joey Bosa remains a free agent and apparently it's going to remain that way for the foreseeable future. 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa said May 28 that his older brother was "working on his golf game" and not thinking about football.
